title: Brazil sightings
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Brazil sightings, about unspecified at Brazil, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They're using different words to describe what they saw in Brazil.

plain: An author on occult and intelligence history, Peter Levenda, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that witnesses of sightings in Brazil used different words to describe what they saw. He raises it to show how the language people reach for shapes the accounts we get.
